import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 2000010;
    static final long MOD1 = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD2 = 998244353L;
    static final long BASE = 1000000L;
    static long totalNumbers = 0;
    static long currentIndex = 0;
    static long totalResult = 0;
    static long[] prefixSums = new long[10];
    static List<Long>[] buckets = new ArrayList[10];
    static long n;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            buckets[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static long getInput(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        int sign = 1;
        long val = 0;
        int ch;
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1) break;
            if (ch == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                break;
            }
            if (Character.isDigit(ch)) {
                val = ch - '0';
                break;
            }
        }
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1 || !Character.isDigit(ch)) break;
            val = val * 10 + (ch - '0');
        }
        return sign * val;
    }

    static long modValue(long x) {
        return ((x % MOD2) + MOD2) % MOD2;
    }

    static void generate(long start, int depth) {
        totalNumbers++;
        buckets[depth].add(modValue(totalNumbers - start));
        totalResult = (totalResult + buckets[depth].get(buckets[depth].size() - 1)) % MOD1;
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) {
            generate(start * 10 + d, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    static void process(long number) {
        if (number > n) return;
        if (number * BASE + (BASE - 1) <= n && number * BASE * 10 > n) {
            long prevIdx = totalNumbers;
            for (int level = 0, mult = 1; level <= 6; level++, mult *= 10) {
                int size = buckets[level].size();
                long delta = modValue(prevIdx - number * mult);
                int pos = lowerBound(buckets[level], MOD2 - delta);
                totalResult = (totalResult + delta * size + prefixSums[level] - MOD1 * (size - pos)) % MOD1;
                totalNumbers += size;
            }
            return;
        }
        totalNumbers++;
        totalResult = (totalResult + modValue(totalNumbers - number)) % MOD1;
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) {
            process(number * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        generate(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(buckets[i]);
        }
        totalNumbers = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            process(i);
        }
        System.out.println((totalResult + MOD1) % MOD1);
    }
}
